scientific_integrity: The complete infinite-family homotopy claim is supported by an explicit fixed-orbit clique model, cross-polytope block decomposition, and CW homotopy pushouts; external independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Weight-three translations only; inclusive Hamming scale three; ambient equivariant-homology representations are distinct from fixed-point homotopy. An unindexed equivalent treatment is a residual originality risk. The finite computations serve as checks, not as proof of the infinite family.
title: Fixed-point homotopy for triple flips of scale-three hypercube Vietoris–Rips complexes
